built_exterior.value: 20 February 2026. The exterior of the Jesus Christ tower was completed with its cross. The Glory bell towers and portico are still future work.

reference_alignment.guess: The origin is the listed Wikidata coordinate. The bearing is estimated from the mapped nave centreline and aligned with the bell tower rows.

plinth.guess: A slim rectangular site base bounds the reconstructed church and the ground of its service wing. It was sized from the modeled extremities and the surrounding street grid.
